titles.title: Lead Me To The Cross (of Jesus)

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
How can I be free from sin
Lead me to the cross of Jesus

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
From the guilt, the power, the pain
Lead me to the cross of Jesus

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
There's no other way
No price that i could pay

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines: Simply to the cross i cling

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
This is all i need
This is all I plead

verse.name: c1d
verse.lines: That his blood was shed for me

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
How can i know peace within
Lead me to the cross if Jesus

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Sing a song of joy again
Lead me to the cross of Jesus

verse.name: c2b
verse.lines: From the Father's heart to me

verse.name: c2c
verse.lines:
What a gift of grace
His own righteousness

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
How can I live day by day
Lead me to the cross if Jesus

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
Following his narrow way
Lead me to the cross of Jesus
